jobs.title: Associate, Discretionary Investment Specialists
jobs.description:
About Man Group

Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Man Group takes a partnership approach to working with clients, establishing deep connections and creating tailored solutions to meet their investment goals and those of the millions of retirees and savers they represent.

Headquartered in London, we manage $253.6 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at www.man.com

At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants  here.

* As at 30 June 2026

Purpose of the role

The Discretionary Investment Specialist Associate will have overall responsibility for investment content creation across a group of Man Group’s Discretionary flagship funds. The role requires developing a significant technical specialism in key investment funds within Man’s Discretionary business area, so as to be able to credibly write, and present, investment content in a compelling and effective manner. These materials will need to be prepared on a regular basis for use with Man's institutional and retail client base. A key element of the role will be to develop deep and credible relationships with the relevant Discretionary investment and CPM teams and to become a go-to source for Sales on the sub-set of funds covered. The successful applicant will be expected to produce high quality and professional materials quickly, efficiently and to a high standard.

Responsibilites

- Develop and maintain a full range of investment collateral, including fund marketing (new product launch materials, monthly performance commentaries), technical content (questionnaire and client queries) and sales enablement content (meeting materials, investment outlooks, product updates)

- Shape compelling and differentiated product messaging to help position strategies competitively

- Provide ongoing technical expertise on a set of products to various internal and external stakeholders (including clients), acting as a subject matter expert

- Communicate on specific market events, performance updates, and product milestones

- Partner with the Discretionary portfolio management, CPM, and other key stakeholders across the business so as to ensure content is impactful and of the highest quality

- Write webcasts and performance updates/educational videos to promote fund capabilities and offerings

- Identify opportunities and initiate projects where Investment Specialists can add value for the portfolio manager, sales force and wider business

- Ensure that the latest fund research, analysis and messaging is incorporated into all materials

Technical Competencies:

- Degree level education in a relevant discipline required. CFA, CAIA or IMC qualification is preferred although not essential

- Approx. 2-3 years’ Client Service or Content Creation experience within the industry and a solid understanding of the financial landscape investment management / hedge fund space preferred

- Ability to work with senior members of sales and investment management to support sales priorities

- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Proficient in understanding institutional / retail client expectations and requirements Good organisational and time management skills.

- Ability to prioritise work effectively

- Ability to work independently within a team to meet demanding deadlines.

- Works comfortably in an entrepreneurial environment, seeks to continuously enhance own relevant skills

- Good ability in Word, PowerPoint and Excel Strong analytical ability with good attention to detail / accuracy.

Inclusion, Work-Life Balance and Benefits at Man Group
You'll thrive in our working environment that champions equality of opportunity. Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you'll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. Learn more at www.man.com/diversity .

You'll have opportunities to make a difference through our charitable and global initiatives, while advancing your career through professional development, and with flexible working arrangements available too. Like all our people, you'll receive two annual 'Mankind' days of paid leave for community volunteering.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes competitive holiday entitlements, pension/401k, life and long-term disability coverage, group sick pay, enhanced parental leave and long-service leave. Depending on your location, you may also enjoy additional benefits such as private medical coverage, discounted gym membership options and pet insurance.

Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

Man Group provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and all employees without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, religion, disability, sex, gender identity and expression, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, age or any other legally protected category or status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

Man Group is a Disability Confident Committed employer; if you require help or information on reasonable adjustments as you apply for roles with us, please contact  TalentAcquisition@man.com .

Purpose of the Role

This position is a core function within the Man Group Systematic team as a Client Portfolio Manager. Man Group’s Systematic Client Portfolio Management Team provide specialist knowledge of Man Group’s Systematic strategies, drive product innovation and engage closely with Man Group’s clients.  The successful applicant is likely to have a passion for markets, quantitative strategies, and a desire to communicate and innovate.

In this role, the individual is expected to work collaboratively with both external clients and internal business partners across Research, Risk, Man Group's global sales force, marketing, legal & compliance teams, middle office and others.

Specific Responsibilities

- Articulate complex systematic concepts in an engaging manner.

- Assume overall responsibility for innovative projects including: planning, organizing timeline and project deliverables.

- Represent Systematics’ investment strategies with investors.

- Quantitative & Qualitative analysis to answer technical questions posed by both clients and internal parties.

- Interact with internal stakeholders including research, marketing and sales.

- Analyze proposal requirements with sales and other appropriate stakeholders, and review provided documentation to identify prospect/client key objectives

Key Competencies

- Strong academic record with substantial mathematical, statistical, or computing components preferred (e.g., Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics etc).

- Excellent oral and written communication skills.

- 5+ years of relevant experience in systematic investment strategies is preferred. However, we encourage applications from individuals with a range of experience levels, as roles can be tailored to match candidate skills and expertise.

- Background in quantitative techniques and investment strategies preferred.

- Proficiency in computer programming (e.g., Python, Matlab, R) is desirable, but we welcome candidates who are eager to learn and develop their coding skills further.

- Strong reasoning ability to understand and explain quantitative investment strategies.

- Highly detail-oriented with the capacity to maintain accuracy in a fast-paced, minimally supervised environment.

- Ability to multi-task and produce quality work under tight time constraints.

Job Profile Summary:

The Quantitative Portfolio Management Analyst role spans a broad spectrum of research, investment, and technical tasks. The successful candidate for this highly competitive position will work closely with a team of Portfolio Managers and other talented Portfolio Analysts to implement the required investment strategies. This involves both validating the inputs to our models as well as the output from the quantitative signals used to make "buy/sell" decisions. The Quantitative Portfolio Management Analyst t will also monitor portfolio risk and country/sector exposures, analyse portfolio returns, and conduct analysis for client communications. ln addition to the day-to-day implementation of the business’ strategies, successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to research projects in conjunction with the central research team.

Responsibilities:

-
Work with Portfolio Managers to validate the inputs and outputs of our investment signals and assist with the day to day management of the portfolio

-
Analyse the output of our portfolio construction process to ensure the integrity of our investment philosophy

-
Work with large data sets and liaise with outside data vendors to identify data quality issues

-
Design tools for evaluating portfolio implementation and performance

-
Assist research teams with enhancing existing signals and creating new signals

-
Conduct analysis for client communication and presentations

Key Skills & Experience:

-
Undergraduate and/or graduate coursework in accounting, finance, statistics, computer science, economics, or mathematics

-
1-3 years of investing experience preferred, outstanding undergraduates will be considered

-
Solid understanding of accounting and financial statement analysis

-
Proficient at Microsoft Excel

-
Coding experience necessary, Python or SAS preferred but not required (we will teach you)

-
Deep interest in investing and the financial markets

-
Strong work ethic and flexible work schedule

-
Detail oriented, good communication skills and a collaborative personality

-
Strong sense of integrity
